manual: Download and import the .ics file into your calendar. This is a manual export, not automatic synchronization.
empty-itinerary: There is no saved itinerary to export.
no-events: No activities have valid start and end times. Review the trip schedule.
invalid-timezone: The destination timezone is missing or invalid. Review the trip schedule.
ambiguous-time: A time is ambiguous during a clock change. Save an explicit valid offset before exporting.
nonexistent-time: A time falls in a daylight-saving gap. Correct the schedule before exporting.
invalid-identity: An activity could not be identified. Reload the trip and try again.
too-large: The itinerary is too large to export as one calendar.
export-failed: Could not prepare the calendar. Please try again.
not-found: This trip or sharing link is unavailable.
unauthorized: Sign in to export your trip.
rate-limited: Too many export requests. Please try again shortly.
invalid-response: The calendar download could not be completed. Please try again.
excluded_one: {{count, number}} item excluded because its schedule is missing, unresolved or invalid.
excluded_other: {{count, number}} items excluded because their schedule is missing, unresolved or invalid.
excluded_few: {{count, number}} items excluded because their schedule is missing, unresolved or invalid.
excluded_many: {{count, number}} items excluded because their schedule is missing, unresolved or invalid.
